name: Ano Hi no Kioku
source: The protagonist, who has been in a coma, wakes up after a year. However he has lost his memory of before the accident. In order to regain his memory, he goes to talk with his childhood friends Kazuma and Ayumi.
translation: 昏迷了一年的主人公，终于醒来，却失去了事故前的记忆。为了找回记忆，他前去与青梅竹马Kazuma和Ayumi交谈。
